title: Design System: Ajith Surya Thati Portfolio

shadows.name: soft-float
shadows.purpose: Quiet separation for a small floating portrait caption or label.

motion.name: portrait-breathe
motion.purpose: Very subtle vertical idle motion on the portrait.

motion.name: pointer-follow
motion.purpose: Softly follows pointer movement without delaying response.

components.name: Primary Action
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 21px; border: 1px solid #0071e3; border-radius: 999px; background: #0071e3; color: #fff; font: 600 .88rem/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; transition: background .2s ease, transform .2s ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #0066cc; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0071e3; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Chapter Navigation
components.description: Plain-language chapter choices with a blue active marker.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; font: 500 .82rem/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: #45454a; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current=
] { color: #0071e3; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0071e3; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Sound Toggle
components.description: Shows whether navigation sounds are enabled.
components.css: .ds-sound { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid #d4e8ff; border-radius: 999px; background: #eaf3ff; color: #075da9; font: 500 .78rem/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-sound:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0071e3; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-sound:active { transform: scale(.98); }

narrative.overview: A welcoming, bright portfolio with generous whitespace, crisp system type, restrained blue accents, and a subtle interactive portrait. Signal language stays in the project's chapter system without dominating the page.
keyCharacteristics: A portrait that responds to pointer and scroll

rules.name: Quiet surface
rules.body: Use near-white surfaces, near-black text, and thin separators.

rules.name: Motion with purpose
rules.body: Make pointer motion immediate and keep idle movement very subtle.
